text.en:
This Decree shall be known as the Charter of the Pambansang Katipunan ng Kabataang
Barangay ng Pilipinas.

Name and Location. In pursuance of the Constitutional principle that the state recognizes the role
of the physical, intellectual, social, and economic well-being, there is hereby created a body corporate to be
known as the Pambansang Katipunan ng Kabataang Barangay ng Pilipinas, hereinafter referred to as the KB
Pambansang Katipunan and directly under the Office of the President of the Philippines.
The main executive office of the KB Pambansa Katipunan shall be in Metro-Manila.

Purposes and Objectives. The Kabataang Barangay shall have the following purposes and
objectives:
(1) To promote total development of the youth, in a manner consistent with the guiding philosophies of the
New Society;
(2) To instill in the youth social commitment and good citizenship, and to assist them in creating a united front
concerted action in helping the government in achieving the country's development goals;
(3) To supplement the efforts of the government in preparing and training both the in-school and out-of-school
youth for citizenship and community life and for gainful employment opportunities so that they can participate
in the fruits of development and progress;

(4) To promote, carry out and conduct scientific inter-disciplinary, and policy-oriented research, studies,
training, scholarships, consultancy for the youth and help in the printing and publication of worthy youth
(5) To encourage and assist the youth in promoting sports, social and cultural activities and in the organization
of youth groups, associations and societies designed to promote the objectives of the Kabataang Barangay;
(6) To undertake any other projects or activities that contribute to the attainment of its general objectives.

Administration of the Pambansang Katipunan Ng Mga Kabataang Barangay. The Pambansang
Katipunan ng Mga Kabataang Barangay Ng Pilipinas shall be administered by an Executive Committee
composed of the Presidents of the thirteen (13) regional Kabataang Barangay organizations. The Members of
the Executive Committee shall choose a Chairman, who shall preside over its meetings. The chairmanship
shall be rotated among the members in accordance with rules and regulations that it may promulgate but the
rotation shall not be more often than once every quarter. The Committee may likewise appoint other officers,
including an executive director, who shall exercise the administrative powers and duties of the Committee in
consultation with the Chairman.
The Committee shall promulgate rules and regulations governing the Kabataang Barangay, providing for,
among others, its detailed organization, the officers of the Executive Committee and their respective powers,
duties and functions, meetings of the organization, rules and regulations governing its officers and employees,
and such other matters necessary for the proper operation of the KB Pambansang Katipunan.

Staff Support and Staffing Pattern. The Executive Committee shall determine, prepare and
approve the necessary staff support and staffing pattern and other related details of the Kabataang Barangay as
may be necessary for the attainment of its purposes and objectives.

Authority to Raise Funds. The KB Pambansang Katipunan is hereby authorized to receive; 1)
donations, 2) bequeaths 3) the net receipts from one draw of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office for
which purpose the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes is hereby authorized to hold one draw every year; and 4)
funds from other sources.

Budget. The committee shall approve an annual budget for the KB Pambansang Katipunan and
such other operating budgets as may be submitted to it by the Committee Chairman. Approval of the same by
the Committee shall be final, and shall not be subject to any other approval by any Government Office,
excepts as provided in the succeeding Sections.

Appropriations for the Pambansang Katipunan Ng Mga Kabataang Barangay Ng Pilipinas. There
is hereby not appropriated from any funds of the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated the sum of
Eleven Million Pesos in the national budget for Calendar Year 1977 and the same amount every calendar year
thereafter, and until otherwise provided by law.

Administration of Government Funds. The appropriations herein provided in the preceding
section shall be released to, and administered by, the Board of Trustees of the Kabataang Barangay
Foundation, Inc., which is hereby authorized to administer government funds for the Kabataang Barangay:
Provided, however, That the KB Pambansang Katipunan shall be given sufficient discretion in the
programming of its expenditures, that twenty-five percent of the annual appropriations of Eleven Million
pesos shall be immediately released to the Kabataang Barangay, and that the remaining seventy-five percent
and incomes arising therefrom shall be released to the KB Pambansang Katipunan on a feasibility basis. Other
funds of the KB Pambansang Katipunan from sources specified in this Decree and any other sources shall be
under the executive control of the Committee.

Autonomy of Operations. The KB Pambansang Katipunan shall be independent of all
government offices and agencies in its operations. Even as it is encourage to develop active lines of
coordination and communication with government offices and agencies, it shall be solely responsible for all
its policies and operations. At the end of each calendar year, it shall submit an annual report of its activities,
receipts and disbursements for the year, to the President of the Philippines.

Autonomy of Financial Operations. Except as otherwise provided in this Decree the KB
Pambansang Katipunan shall have control over the disbursements of its funds. In the same manner, the
Executive Committee shall insure that financial autonomy shall similarly be exercised by all levels of
organization in the Kabataang Barangay, whether local, regional or national. The funds of the KB
Pambansang Katipunan Are declared a public trust, to be used for the benefit of the Filipino youth. These
funds, therefore, shall be subject to the visitorial powers given by the Constitution to the Commission on

Tax Exemption. The KB Pambansang Katipunan shall be exempted from all forms of taxation
or other impositions, whether local or national, and shall be free from all duties and all other imposts on any
equipment, articles, or goods which it may import, when reasonably necessary for use in its operations.

Inconsistent Laws and Provisions. All provisions of decrees, orders, and other rules and
regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified accordingly. However, all budgetary
appropriations made by the different government agencies involved in Kabataang Barangay activities shall
continue to be funded.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 1st day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
